Ava: Heads-up 1: Acme Health asked for a light pilot of the Optimize toolkit. Goals: per-route batching/caching/quant recs, and eval-triggered alerts for degradation. They want tight onboarding and clear QA gates. Thoughts on a minimal safe MVP?
Lee: MVP should be read-only recommendations + alerts to webhook/console. No autopilot. Keep UI minimal: a single per-route card with recommended actions and a confidence score.
Priya: Agree. For signals, let's support two: (1) metric regression (accuracy/precision/F1) against labeled seed sets, (2) semantic drift via embedding cosine distribution shift. Also add a simple heuristic: mean token-per-response change.
Marco: Data ask: we need request traces (route, model, token_count, latency, status_code) for the last 30 days plus the seed labelled dataset. Acme Health can surface ~300 labeled prompts across three routes but wants to add more after kickoff.
Ben: Implementation plan: run a simulation engine offline that replays traces to estimate batching benefit and caching hits. Output a ranked list: [{route, rec_type, params, est_latency_savings, est_cost_savings, est_quality_delta, confidence_bucket}]. Example: {"route":"/v1/diagnose","rec_type":"batch","params":{"batch_size":6},"est_latency_savings":0.18,"est_quality_delta":0.005,"confidence":"high"} 
Ava: Good. We should include quantization suggestions as experimental with 'expected_quality_delta' and an explicit opt-in flag for customers.
Lee: Alerting behavior: require two consecutive rolling windows to be breached before firing webhook. Provide reason payload: metric_name, baseline_value, current_value, p_value (if applicable), example failing prompt ids. Webhook schema should be stable.
Priya: For console: simple timeline + alert history + ability to mark an alert as investigated. Also a CSV export for recs so Acme's compliance team can archive decisions. No apply button for MVP.
Marco: Acceptance criteria proposal: (1) recommendations judged useful by Acme engineers >= 70% on initial survey, (2) alerts precision >= 85% on pilot dataset, (3) onboarding time <= 3 hours, (4) no more than 2 severity-1 bugs during pilot.
Ben: Risks: simulated savings might differ from production. Mitigation: surface expected variance and show simulation assumptions. Also limit pilot ingestion rate to 500k events/day and redact PII before ingestion.
Ava: Timeline suggestion: 4 sprints. Sprint 1: trace ingestion + sim engine prototype. Sprint 2: API + webhook alerting. Sprint 3: Console cards + CSV export + docs. Sprint 4: Pilot polish, quant profiles flagged experimental, run onboarding. Pilot kickoff target = 6 weeks.
Priya: Need to define evaluation windows and sample sizes for alerts, suggest minimum 200 eval samples per route or else require longer window. Also confirm embedding model for drift (we should pin to a specific embedding model version for consistency).
Lee: Ops items: ensure telemetry retention for pilot (90 days), add rate limit for /v1/optimize/trace ingest, and KMS for any stored seeds. I'll open tickets.
ops-bot: Note: Pilot sync scheduled Friday 9:00 AM.
Ava: Next steps: Ben will draft the recommendation output schema + example payloads by Wed EOD, Priya will draft alert rule config and eval window guidance by Thu, Marco will get trace access from Acme and confirm sample sizes. We'll review at Friday sync. :rocket:
